record.title: Enguri departure restriction during Georgian election runoffs, October 2021
record.scope: Named crossing or its access; no whole-country closure or new outline inferred.
record.direction: Abkhazia to Georgian government-controlled territory; no reverse-direction ban established.
record.movement: Ordinary departures from Abkhazia, excluding people needing medical assistance
record.exceptions: People needing medical assistance were excepted in the SSG account.
record.imposing_authority: Abkhaz de facto authorities, as reported by the Georgian State Security Service
record.enforcement: SSG reports ordinary-departure restrictions for 28–30 October, with medical exceptions. Rustavi 2 reports departures possible by 1 November; the first actual return day is not identified.
record.relationship: Distinct from CC018 pandemic measures, CC030 October 2024 elections and CC032 April 2023 rally. Full Register and phase scan found no October 2021 counterpart.
record.status_observation: Historical dated evidence only; current operating status unknown.
record.official_rationale: The SSG links the restriction to the Georgian local-election runoff. This qualified electoral classification does not adopt its criticism as a proven Abkhaz official rationale or add a separate Security code.
record.context: See the source-specific chronology; no present border status is asserted.
record.uncertainty: Obtain the imposing authority’s original notice and evidence of actual lifting; retain the medical exception and departure-only scope.
record.current_timing: 2 linked phases; see Chronology phases; do not add overlapping durations
record.current_corrections: The 28–30 October dates remain the reported inclusive restriction schedule. Rustavi 2 confirms that ordinary departures were possible by 1 November, but does not date the first resumed passage. Medical exceptions and departure-only scope remain; no exact operational duration or 30 October observed reopening is assigned.
